questions.question: When Jesus went to eat at a Pharisee's house, what surprised the Pharisee?

answers.text: Jesus did not first wash before the meal
Jesus did not first give thanks for the meal
Jesus took the seat of honor at the meal

questions.question: Jesus said the Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish. What are they full of inside?
Jesus compared the Pharisees to unmarked graves. What do people do with graves like that?

answers.text: Go the long way around them

questions.question: Jesus said the experts in the law weigh people down with heavy burdens. What did He say they would not do?

answers.text: Lift a finger to lighten their load
Explain the reason for the rules
Pay the men who carry them
